assessments.summary: Conditional on the explicitly assumed binary-input Marton-equals-randomized-time-division theorem, the argument exhausts all supports of size at most two. Adjacent and antirepetition supports admit cooperative BEC(1/2) converses, while the repetition support is bounded via the assumed theorem and a rigorous concavity/interval calculation by 0.614336840676774 bits, hence strictly below 0.615. Since the stated product RTD baseline exceeds 0.7232857688439092 bits, any strict two-letter improvement must use at least three super-input symbols.
scopeQualifications: Validity is conditional on the Geng–Jog–Nair–Wang theorem explicitly assumed in the claim.
The numerical product RTD benchmark is treated as supplied problem data; the execution attestation does not independently prove it.
The result only excludes supports of cardinality at most two and makes no assertion against gains using three- or four-symbol support.
